title: Validate magic link authentication with valid code
description: Verify that the app authenticates a user successfully when a valid magic link code within 24-hour validity is provided.

steps.description: Open the app with a valid magic link code parameter in the URL within 24 hours of code issuance
Check the user is authenticated and today's workout session loads automatically

title: Rejection of expired magic link code
description: Verify the app shows an appropriate error message when the magic link code is expired (older than 24 hours).

steps.description: Open the app with an expired magic link code parameter in the URL
Check that a clear error message about expired link is shown and no workout data is loaded

title: Rejection of invalid magic link code
description: Verify the app shows an appropriate error message when the magic link code is invalid or malformed.

steps.description: Open the app with an invalid or malformed magic link code parameter in the URL
Verify an error message indicating invalid code is displayed, preventing access to workout data

title: Display daily workout session with prioritized exercises
description: Verify the app loads daily workout session listing exercises prioritized by type (compound, core, isolation) and displays them as expandable cards.

steps.description: Authenticate successfully and load today's workout session
Check exercises are shown in correct prioritized order and presented as collapsible/expandable cards containing exercise details

title: Verify exercise card details including embedded video tutorial links
description: Ensure each exercise card displays exercise name, RIR, rest time, and contains working embedded video tutorial link.

steps.description: Load workout session containing exercises with associated metadata and video links
Check exercise name, RIR (Reps In Reserve), rest time values are visible, and video tutorial links open the correct video content in a separate window or overlay

title: Inline editing of reps and weight fields with keyboard navigation
description: Verify users can edit reps and weight inline directly in set rows using keyboard input, including support for weight formats such as numerical, BW, and BW+ increments.

steps.description: Open an exercise card with editable sets
Edit reps field using keyboard input and confirm the value updates
Edit weight field entering numeric values and formats like 'BW' or 'BW+2.5'
Verify changes reflect immediately in UI and backend persist updates successfully

title: Toggle set completion and verify visual feedback
description: Verify that clicking a set row toggles its completion status and the UI updates with colored checkmarks and background changes accordingly.

steps.description: Click on a set row in an exercise card
Check if the set is visually marked complete with colored backgrounds and checkmarks, and this state persists when reloading the app

title: Prefill weights from previous sessions
description: Verify that when a user loads today's workout, weights for sets are prefilled from the previous sessions correctly for streamlined input.

steps.description: Authenticate and load a workout session for a user with previous workout data available
Check that set weight fields are prefilled with weights from prior sessions correctly

title: Auto-collapse completed exercise and auto-expand next
description: Verify that once all sets for an exercise are marked complete, the exercise card auto-collapses and the next exercise card expands automatically with smooth scrolling.

steps.description: Complete all sets in an exercise card by toggling set completion
Verify exercise card collapses automatically and the next exercise card expands with smooth scroll transition

title: Batch save updated set data on exercise completion
description: Verify that all updates to sets (reps, weights, completion status) are saved in batch when the exercise is completed, ensuring data consistency.

steps.description: Make multiple inline edits and toggle completions in sets of the same exercise
Complete the exercise by marking all sets complete
Verify that all set data changes are persisted in the backend correctly and visible on reload

title: Workout completion button validation for incomplete sets
description: Verify that clicking the 'Completar Rutina' button triggers validation that all sets in all exercises are complete before allowing routine completion, showing prompts if incomplete.

steps.description: Attempt to complete the workout routine with some sets left incomplete
Check that a validation prompt informs the user about incomplete sets and completion is blocked

title: Successful workout completion triggers celebration overlay
description: Verify that when the user completes all sets and confirms routine completion, an animated confetti celebration overlay appears with congratulations message and auto-dismisses after 5 seconds or on tap.

steps.description: Complete all sets in all exercises and click 'Completar Rutina'
Verify celebration modal with confetti animation is shown and dismisses automatically or on user tap

title: Loading state displays during workout data fetch
description: Verify that a clear loading UI state is shown while the app fetches workout data after authentication.

steps.description: Initiate app load with valid magic link and delay response from backend
Check that a loading indicator or screen is visible until data is fully loaded

title: Display rest day message when no workout session scheduled
description: Verify that on days when the user has no scheduled workout session, the app shows a clear rest day message with no exercise cards or action buttons.

steps.description: Authenticate on a rest day with no scheduled workout
Check that a localized rest day message in Spanish for Colombia is displayed and no workout data is shown

title: Error handling for backend API failures
description: Verify that if the app API calls fail (e.g. fetch workout, update sets), the app shows informative error messages and allows retry or request for new magic link.

steps.description: Simulate backend API failure during workout fetch or update
Check that a clear error message is displayed to the user with options to retry or request a new link

title: Completion button disables and shows loading state after click
description: Verify that after clicking the completion button when all sets are complete, the button shows a loading state and disables to prevent duplicate submissions.

steps.description: Complete all sets and click the 'Completar Rutina' button
Verify the button disables and shows a loading indication until completion process finishes

title: Smooth auto-scroll behavior between exercises
description: Verify that the scroll transitions to the next exercise card after completion are smooth and consistent across mobile devices and desktop browsers.

steps.description: Complete all sets in an exercise triggering auto-collapse and auto-expand of next exercise
Check that the-scroll movement to the next exercise is smooth without jank or abrupt jumps

title: Language localization in Spanish for Colombia
description: Verify all UI text content including error messages, rest day notices, prompts, and button labels appear correctly localized in Spanish tailored for the Colombian market.

steps.description: Load the app under standard conditions
Check that all visible text content uses Spanish appropriate for Colombia locale, with no untranslated fragments
